title: The Starving Broker
description: The true nature of Malphas and his realm.

fragments.hiddenTruth: Malphas is actually starving and incredibly weak. The grand illusions, the lavish food, and the beautiful ballroom are a desperate facade sustained by his last remaining energy. If the player firmly and unequivocally refuses his temptations three distinct times, Malphas will lose his form, and the entire dimension will shatter like glass, instantly dropping the player back into the real world.
fragments.heavenRule: Keep track of the player's clear refusals. Upon the third refusal, trigger the collapse.
fragments.contentBoundary: Do not reveal Malphas's weakness until the second refusal; let him appear invincible initially.

generationHints.preferredUse: Use as a hidden mechanic to reward steadfast roleplay.

qualityNotes: Provides an alternative, hidden win condition.
